what: interpretable IRES metrics, same physics as L_IRES
reference_construction: circular full-length partition function with every non-IRES nucleotide forced unpaired; identical to constrained_ires_reference() used for L_IRES

definitions.ires_native_recall_hard: of ref pairs with p>=0.5, fraction still p>=0.5 in candidate
definitions.ires_native_recall_soft: mean candidate probability over the same ref pair set
definitions.ires_cross_occupancy: fraction of IRES residues that pair outside the IRES (p>=0.5)
definitions.ires_unpaired_frac: fraction of IRES residues with total pairing probability <0.5
definitions.ires_mean_pair_prob: mean total pairing probability per IRES residue
